title: Rhinos in Tanzania: Black Rhino Facts
excerpt: Black rhinos are critically endangered. Facts about how they live and where you might see one in Tanzania.
body:
## Black rhino

Tanzania's wild rhinos are black rhinos. They have a pointed, hooked upper lip for browsing.

## Behaviour

Mostly solitary. They have poor eyesight but good hearing and smell.

## Threats

Poaching for their horns has drastically reduced numbers. Protection efforts have helped some populations recover.

## Where

- [Ngorongoro Crater](/blog/ngorongoro-rhinos/).
- Parts of the Serengeti.
- [Mkomazi sanctuary](/blog/mkomazi-rhino-sanctuary/).

## Respect
